about: Per-(bed, split) seed ledger (BLOCKER-SYNTHESIS S0-5). Checked by experiments/jit/seeds.mjs assertSeedsAllowed (stream.mjs config validation) and by experiments/kev-data/lib/registry.mjs (the Kev factory refuses every range here that another owner holds as reserved or fresh). A seed range applies to every difficulty. beds ['*'] means every bed. allow: the purposes that may use the range (null: any purpose); a purpose with fresh: true also refuses ranges whose status is used or burned. Edit this file when a run consumes a range (status fresh -> used), in the same commit as the run's config.
